arguments.content: P1 review pattern: Input-normalization changes can silently bypass reliability policy when a public read path is redirected from a retry-owning operation to its single-attempt primitive. A passing unit test may entrench the regression by expecting the first transient exception. Review the whole public call chain and compare success-after-transient, retry exhaustion, and permanent-error behavior against the existing contract. Keep normalization before the policy-owning operation; verify normalized keys on every retry. Observed in preference reads: read_preferences switched from read_resilient(key) to read_once(key.strip()); public reads then failed after one transient instead of recovering within the three-attempt budget.
